::: {#exm-relation-composition}
#### Grandparents and siblings

- The grandparent relation of @exr-grandparent is the composition (@def-relation-composition) of the relation $P$ of @exm-parent with itself:

  $$
  P \circ P = \set{(\text{Ada}, \text{Dev}), (\text{Ada}, \text{Eva})}.
  $$

- In $P \circ P^{-1}$, a person $a$ is related to $c$ when some $b$ has $a \mathrel{P^{-1}} b$ and $b \mathrel{P} c$,
  that is, when $b$ is a parent of $a$ and of $c$ (@exm-inverse-relation).
  So $P \circ P^{-1}$ is the relation "has a parent in common with":

  $$
  \begin{aligned}
  P \circ P^{-1}
  = \{&(\text{Ben}, \text{Ben}), (\text{Ben}, \text{Cora}), (\text{Cora}, \text{Ben}), (\text{Cora}, \text{Cora}), \\
  &(\text{Dev}, \text{Dev}), (\text{Eva}, \text{Eva})\}.
  \end{aligned}
  $$

  Ada is in no pair, since her parents are not in $F$.

:::
